summary: Completed backend regression and mobile/PWA/auth integration checks on preview URL. Backend suites passed (protected APIs, CRUD, exports, team roles, password reset rules). Frontend mobile/desktop navigation, overflow, CRUD flows (project/activity/report/issue with attachments), PDF/XLSX downloads, pending-user gate, and AI 2-message chat were validated. One genuine PWA offline fallback failure was reproduced during hard navigation offline.

ui_bugs.issue: When offline and doing hard navigation, app did not render /offline.html fallback; preview showed load failure overlay for missing bundle.js instead.

integration_issues.issue: Offline banner appears after offline toggle, but hard-nav offline can fail before reaching page actions, so save-failure UX is not consistently reachable in this path.

action_items: Fix service-worker offline hard-navigation fallback so /offline.html reliably renders when network is down.
Re-verify offline save-failure UX after fallback fix (current hard-nav path can crash before form actions).
Optional code-quality: Clerk console warns about structural CSS selectors targeting Clerk internals (.cl-userButton*); consider Clerk UI pinning strategy to avoid breakage on Clerk updates.
Provide /app/auth_testing.md and /app/image_testing.md docs if they are required playbook artifacts for future testing agents.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend continues using process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly; no hardcoded API base URL found in reviewed files.
Service worker cache scope is correctly limited to public assets (offline page + icons) and excludes API/auth routes, which is good for privacy and auth safety.
Observed runtime warning from Clerk about structural CSS selectors depending on Clerk internal DOM; this can cause future UI breakage when Clerk updates components.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_MOBILE project/activity/report/issue with small PNG/TXT attachments; exported PDF/XLSX; AI test chat created/deleted; TEST_MOBILE project deleted. Engineer password was temporarily changed for reset-flow verification and restored to original. Pending user remained pending.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Key validated states: manager reset engineer password via Team UI; old engineer password rejected; temporary password accepted; original password restored and re-verified. Pending account still gated. Mobile nav and route overflow checks passed on 320/390/768/1024/1440. Offline hard navigation currently fails to show offline fallback page.
rca of the issue: RCA (offline bug): SW is registered and cache contains only public assets, but hard offline navigation still surfaced host load-failure overlay instead of rendering /offline.html. This indicates navigate requests are not consistently being served by SW fallback in this preview path (likely control/timing or host-level interception during bundle fetch). Repro: sign in -> set offline -> hard navigate to a route/nonexistent path -> expected offline.html, observed load failure overlay. Mitigation: verify SW controls current client before navigation, ensure fetch handler always catches navigate failures for controlled pages, and re-test offline route transitions in both SPA navigation and hard refresh paths.
